remarks: This beautifully restored colonial home is situated on a picturesque 4.5-acre estate in one of the most prestigious areas of Greenwich - the Round Hill Historic District. Savor the calming nature views throughout each room in this charming home. Recent renovations include restoration of the hardwood floors, new lighting fixtures and modern window treatments. Bedroom on first floor will be great as a Guest Room or In-Law Suite! Enjoy all the luxuries this quintessential coastal New England town offers from parks, gardens and hiking to authentic restaurants, cafes, and shopping. Enjoy the local and spectacular Tod's Point Beach. You are within minutes to downtown Greenwich Avenue, Route15, I95 and Westchester Airport. *Main House for Rent Only. Estate includes stable, barn, dog kennel and cottage.
